title: The Mitten Box

intro.speaker: greta
intro.text: Every winter, the people of Bellhaven put coins in the mitten box, so every child in the city has warm mittens.

intro.speaker: greta
intro.text: Would you please count the coins? Stack them in fives, so they're easy to count.

steps.speaker: greta
steps.prompt: Put five coins in each stack. Count as you go.
steps.hint: Find a stack with an empty dip, and put a coin there.

older.prompt: Make stacks of ten coins: five stacks. No dips to help, so count carefully.

feedback.full: That stack is done. Try the next one.
feedback.all_good: Four stacks of five: twenty coins! Enough for lots of mittens.

outro.speaker: greta
outro.text: Twenty coins! That's enough for ten pairs of warm mittens. Ten children with cosy hands!

journal_line: I counted the coins in Bellhaven's mitten box.

outro.speaker: greta
outro.text: Five stacks of ten: fifty coins! That's mittens for twenty-five children!

older.journal_line: I counted fifty coins in tens for Bellhaven's mitten box.
